full_details: At ten of the clock you were at the Theatre with James and Cuthbert, on the north side. The playhouse was empty. James put his knife two inches into a spongy oak post laid in 1576. The lease is twenty-one years. The ground falls back to Giles Allen on the thirteenth of April, 1597, and Allen is slow to renew. Cuthbert asked who would pay the carpenter. You did not name a price. You said you would give two mornings in Lent, in March, and leave the law to the family. You played Egeon at the Cross Keys at two, and the part has you idle after the opening until the end. At supper you told the house the post was damp. You named no sum. Master Verbeke sat at the table and did not speak of it.
one_sentence: James Burbage put a knife two inches into a rotten post, and you gave him two mornings in March.
title: A knife two inches into rotten oak
